acceptance: A report (PR description or docs/internal note) over at least 14 days of ci.yml runs that classifies every non-success: real test failure, duration gate, timeout or cancel, superseded or cancelled, infrastructure; with counts and rates
For the duration gate: per-run distribution of the summed ratio and delta on runs with no relevant test changes, and the false-positive rate at the current 1.30 / 360 s thresholds
For macOS framing: queued time vs execution time split, p50/p90/p99 execution time, and how often the 15-minute limit is hit on execution alone
Each proposed change has its data, expected first-pass gain, and risk; DECISION GATE: owner approves or rejects each via the choice dialog before any threshold or timeout is edited
Approved changes land with tests; rejected ones are recorded on this item
context:
Serial item (not in the batch). Owner decision 2026-11-05: investigate only; every gate threshold or timeout change needs owner approval. GUARDRAILS: no change to thresholds, timeouts, retries or required checks without that approval; re-running jobs to collect data is fine. No PR merges while develop is frozen for 0.5.0 (dlv2-52 owner decision 1) or during a G13 release window; the investigation report itself may proceed at any time. Rollback for any approved change: revert its commit.

2026-11-06 observed: tests/unit/test_heavy_choke_points.py failed the ubuntu py3.14 fast leg 5 times on PR #3982. Tests using the default stub machine name `m` race under pytest-xdist: the cleanup helper sees sibling tests' wrapper processes and leaves the machine running (reproduced locally with -n 4). Likely introduced by #3972. Candidate fix: a unique STUB_MACHINE per test, as lines 333 and 424 of that file already do.
description: CI first-pass green fell from the 70.4% baseline to about 47% (n=100 ci.yml runs since 2026-11-01). Observed drivers: the fast-tier duration gate tripping on runner variance (for example #3946: summed ratio 1.354 against 1.30, +504 s, with no slow tests from the PR) and macOS TPC-H binary framing hitting its 15-minute limit under queue load on many PRs. The owner chose 'investigate only' on 2026-11-05, so this item gathers the data and proposes changes; any threshold or timeout change needs explicit owner approval before it is implemented.
